name: claude-trello
description: Trello integration for Claude Desktop. View boards, manage cards, move tasks, and add comments.

trello_api_key.title: Trello API Key
trello_api_key.description: From trello.com/power-ups/admin → select your Power-Up (or create one) → API Key.

trello_token.title: Trello Token
trello_token.description: On the same API Key page, click 'Generate a Token' and authorise access.
